title: The API fails at displaying tags

labels.name: issue/confirmed
labels.description: Issue has been reviewed and confirmed to be present or accepted to be implemented

body:
- Gitea version (or commit ref): 1.14.0+dev-414-g4ef751215
- OS: Docker
- Database (use `[x]`):

  - [X] MySQL
  - [ ] MSSQL
  - [ ] SQLite
- Can you reproduce the bug at https://try.gitea.io:

## Description

The API fails at displaying tags at https://*/api/v1/repos/nesbot/carbon/tags

### Migrated Repo to test

https://github.com/briannesbitt/Carbon.git

### Migration Error on try.gitea.io

Migrieren von https://github.com/briannesbitt/Carbon.git fehlgeschlagen.
